title: LEDGER: Auditable Agent Memory Under Change
abstract: arXiv:2611.20927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent memory systems are mostly evaluated on fixed histories, and only their final answers are scored. In real use, facts change, sources differ in reliability, and users ask the agent to forget things. We present LEDGER, a memory layer in which a language model proposes facts and explicit rules decide which value is current, which source to trust, and what to delete. Each fact keeps its source and the period in which it held. LEDGER+EP adds a search over raw conversation turns for questions the ledger does not cover, and scrubs these turns on deletion. We compare both against no memory, full-history replay, retrieval over raw transcripts, and Mem0, with the same answering model and prompt, on a synthetic multi-session coding-agent workload and a 210-question subset of LongMemEval, and we score both the evidence each memory sends to the model and the answer. On the coding workload, LEDGER+EP in fallback mode answers 94.3% of questions

translated_title: LEDGER：可审计的、能应对事实变更的智能体记忆系统
translated_abstract: 智能体记忆系统大多是在固定历史数据上进行评估的，且只对最终答案进行打分。而在实际使用中，事实会发生变化，不同来源的可靠性各不相同，用户还会要求智能体遗忘某些内容。我们提出了 LEDGER，这是一种记忆层，由语言模型提出事实，而显式规则决定哪个值是当前有效的、应该信任哪个来源、以及应该删除什么内容。每个事实都保留其来源信息及其成立的时期。LEDGER+EP 在此基础上增加了对原始对话轮次的搜索，用于处理账本未覆盖的问题，并在删除时对这些轮次进行清除。我们在相同的回答模型和提示词下，将两种系统与无记忆、全历史重放、对原始记录的检索以及 Mem0 进行比较，实验基于一个合成的多会话编程智能体工作负载和 LongMemEval 的 210 题子集，并且我们对每个记忆系统发送给模型的证据和最终答案都进行打分。在编程工作负载上，LEDGER+EP 在回退模式下回答了 94.3% 的问题……
tldr: 提出了 LEDGER，一个可审计的智能体记忆层，由语言模型提出事实、显式规则决定当前有效值、可信来源和删除操作，并记录每个事实的来源与有效期，从而应对真实场景中事实变更、来源可靠性差异和用户遗忘请求等挑战。
en_tdlr: LEDGER is an auditable agent memory layer in which a language model proposes facts and explicit rules decide which value is current, which source to trust, and what to delete, with each fact keeping its source and validity period to handle changing facts, differing source reliability, and user forgetting requests.
